relationships.subject: Histone hypoacetylation
relationships.evidence_quote: partial sciatic nerve ligation was shown to selectively induce histone hypoacetylation within C-fibers, suppressing transcription at the MOR and Nav1.8 sodium channel loci

relationships.subject: HDAC class II
relationships.evidence_quote: pharmacological inhibition of class II HDACs in the spinal cord attenuates thermal hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: TET1
relationships.evidence_quote: TET1-mediated demethylation of the promoters of genes encoding mu-opioid receptors (MORs) and voltage-gated potassium channels (Kv1.2) in dorsal root ganglion neurons has been demonstrated to alleviate neuropathic pain

key_findings: Review of epigenetic mechanisms (DNA methylation, histone modification, ncRNA) in pain, opioid tolerance and anesthetic effects.
